Both source/native EAF supplies use scrap as the iron-bearing input together with alloying feedstock; the native definition includes steelmaking and casting and has no rolling input. Preserve signed kg at factor +1 and the complete native feedstock, alloying, energy, internal freight, infrastructure, residues and emissions once. Do not add hot rolling, a converter share, metal-yield/alloy-content scaling, extra scrap or a recovery credit, and retain separately listed caller fabrication/transport. Native historical European EAF/alloy averages approximate the global source producers; detailed alloy composition, furnace/secondary-metallurgy efficiency, allocation, internal recycling and residue routes, delivery, geography, biosphere definitions and vintage differ. These are screening limitations with unquantified score effects, not exact alloy or LCIA equivalence. Only the enumerated cut-off profile is admitted.
